name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-11-04, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
